images.title: Hours and minutes on a double number line
images.purpose: A double number line with hours 0 to 6 above and minutes 0 to 360 below, an arrow marked × 60, and 5 hours = 5 × 60 = 300 minutes written below.
images.composition: A caption at the top, a double number line with its two row names, an arrow marked × 60, one marked pair of ticks, and the example written large at the bottom.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. TOP LEFT: the caption Hours and minutes on a double number line in dark #1F2937 sans-serif bold (36 px), left edge at x 100, about y 70. ROW NAMES: the word Hours centred at x 150, y 330 and the word Minutes centred at x 150, y 490, in dark bold (36 px). TOP LINE: one thin dark #2B2B2B horizontal line (5 px) at y 330 from x 260 to x 1280 with exactly 7 tick marks 44 px tall, at x 260, 430, 600, 770, 940, 1110, 1280, labelled above the line at about y 295 with 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 (40 px, bold, dark). BOTTOM LINE: the same, one line at y 490 from x 260 to x 1280 with exactly 7 tick marks at the same x positions (each tick exactly below one tick of the top line), labelled below the line at about y 545 with 0, 60, 120, 180, 240, 300, 360 (40 px, bold, dark). ARROW: one amber #E69F00 straight arrow (6 px) from the top tick at x 430 (y 352) down to the bottom tick at x 430 (y 468), arrowhead at the bottom, with the label × 60 to the right of it at x 460, about y 410 (44 px, bold, dark). MARKS: an amber #E69F00 dot (24 px across) on the top tick at x 1110 and on the bottom tick at x 1110, joined by a thin dashed amber vertical line, with the label 5 × 60 = 300 centred between the two lines at x 910, about y 410 (44 px, bold, dark). BOTTOM: centred at x 728 and about y 700, one line of bold dark text, 5 hours = 5 × 60 = 300 minutes (64 px), the largest text in the frame. Nothing else in the frame.
labels: Hours and minutes on a double number line
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
more or fewer than 7 ticks on a line, ticks that are not directly one above the other, or a bottom label that is not 60 times the top label
an amber mark on any tick other than 5 on the top line and 300 on the bottom line
images.takeaway: 1 hour is 60 minutes, so every hour along the line is 60 more minutes: 5 hours is 5 × 60 = 300 minutes.
images.description: A double number line with hours 0 to 6 above and minutes 0 to 360 below, an arrow marked × 60, and 5 hours = 5 × 60 = 300 minutes written below.
images.context: Concept image for Hours and Minutes. It follows the idea of the double number line in your maths book (hours above, minutes below, equal steps) and shows the concept's own example of 5 hours.
images.teaching_notes: Slide a finger along the line: one hour, 60 minutes; two hours, 120 minutes. The slip to watch: counting an hour as 100 minutes.

image_decisions.why: The double number line shows that each hour is 60 more minutes, which is the whole conversion.
